subject: skill/stack/firebase-hosting
claim: Configure Firebase Hosting in firebase.json: public selects the deploy directory (this repo uses "public": "." under apps/website), redirects issue an HTTP redirect while rewrites serve the destination file (or a Cloud Function/Run service) without one. Response priority is fixed — reserved /__/* namespaces, then redirects, then exact-match static content, then rewrites, then custom 404 — and within redirects/rewrites the FIRST matching rule wins, so order rules deliberately. Validate on a preview channel (firebase hosting:channel:deploy) before firebase deploy --only hosting, and deploy both mirrored projects.
notes: Full-config backs public/ignore, redirects vs rewrites, the documented priority order and first-match ordering, cleanUrls/trailingSlash, headers and the custom 404.html. Deploying backs preview channels, firebase deploy --only hosting and cloning a tested channel to live. Both agree; low uncertainty. The repo-specific mirror step (also --project agentic-dynamics) comes from apps/website/CONTEXT.md, not the corpus.
